etymology.historical_story: The packet provides no evidence establishing the origin of lowercase darpa. One possible identification is the institutional acronym DARPA. Its official history traces the agency to ARPA, established on 7 February 1958. That history explains the agency name, but it does not prove that this unidentified corpus item refers to the agency. [DARPA official history](https://www.darpa.mil/about/innovation-timeline/arpa-is-born)
